scope: Current applicability questions; accepted current-source economics and engineering evidence are retained separately.
scan_rule: Follow research/registry.json families[].research_questions and select status=pending_validation. Read current_evidence separately; a pending hypothesis does not invalidate an accepted bounded result.

questions.question: Can a joint quote/value mapping improve full-account net value?
questions.question_zh: 联合报价与价值映射能否改善完整账户净价值？
gaps: The completed prefill E/C and bounded risk-widen results are separate contracts, not a validation of every historical joint-P3 or soft-widen selector.
Bind the actual source, model, baseline, action semantics, accounting and previous-use; an old point estimate or closure label is not a current conclusion.
questions.next_validation: Bind the POST/WAIT or quote-widen intervention, decision-visible features and non-fill opportunities; compare net total/unit returns and inventory rather than selected fills alone.

questions.question: Which decision-visible states predict marginal fill value including subsequent inventory repair?
questions.question_zh: 哪些决策前可见状态能预测包含后续库存修复的边际成交价值？
gaps: Ex-post bad fills and survival-conditioned subsets do not establish a profitable intervention.
Bind the actual source, model, baseline, action semantics, accounting and previous-use; an old point estimate or closure label is not a current conclusion.
questions.next_validation: Include filled, unfilled and cancelled opportunities; distinguish short markout, marginal lot value and full-account terminal accounting.

questions.question: Can multiscale market state select post-fill cooldowns that improve complete-account net value rather than merely suppress turnover or delay useful inventory reduction?
questions.question_zh: 多尺度市场状态选择成交后冷却时长，能否改善完整账户净价值，而非仅压低成交或延误有价值的减仓？
questions.historical_observation: The August Development report described a favorable BUY E3 relative point estimate, negative absolute value and unmet interval/hierarchy conditions. Neither success nor universal invalidity on the current source follows.
gaps: Historical30-day panel, old baseline and modeled execution semantics.
Model-selection performance is not independent confirmation of a final refit.
Old side-specific repairs and previous-use must be bound; do not inherit every old threshold as a universal gate.
questions.next_validation: Continue the already authorized same-family redo after current training/data/baseline bindings. Preserve the declared action question and compare complete matched accounting, action-frequency controls and inventory effects; do not merely remove failed historical conditions.

questions.question: Are slow quote updates associated with fills at locally unfavorable prices, and does a defined update intervention improve complete-account value?
questions.question_zh: 是否有一类挂单更新偏慢、容易在局部不利位置成交的情况？
gaps: Historical ex-post shadow labels are not causal proof.
Separate stale input, decision/KEEP behavior, cancel acknowledgment delay, queue effects and cancel-fill races.
Include comparable unfilled/cancelled opportunities, not only selected bad fills.
questions.next_validation: Define decision-visible features and timing; examine short-horizon markout curves and matched opportunity denominators. Any later behavioral test needs a separately bound paired experiment, not an automatic change to a running study.

questions.question: How should markout horizons relate to marginal inventory holding time and risk-reducing actions instead of assuming30seconds or a fixed lifecycle fraction is optimal?
questions.question_zh: markout期限应怎样关联持仓生命周期，而不是默认30秒或某个固定百分比最合适？
gaps: Order lifetime, marginal-fill holding time and flat-to-flat inventory episode differ.
Realized future exit time cannot be a known decision-time input.
Policy-dependent exits, partial closes and censoring can bias normalized-horizon comparisons.
Gross markout is not round-trip net profit; risk reduction may be valuable despite adverse short markout.
questions.next_validation: Retain common fixed short-horizon diagnostics alongside lifecycle net accounting. Study holding-time distributions using authorized training/development support; any adaptive decision horizon uses past-information estimates, not realized future duration. No percentage selected yet.

current_evidence.boundary: Current-source prefill E/C completed 204 independent accounts × ten paths, with four fitted surfaces and train-only T100 labels. All full-calendar and Final paths remain negative; E/EC reduced total loss versus their own B0, C incremental effects were inconsistent, and E Final turnover-normalized returns worsened. Two random seeds do not establish stable selectivity. A separate bounded ten-head risk-widen comparison was negative. Neither result completes multiscale cooldown or every historical first-fill/joint-quote question.
Read the original baseline, completed coverage, previous-use and limitations; this source does not resolve unrelated pending questions.
